as_told.title: Tipler disc time machine as flying saucer

plain: A researcher named Mike Masters, who argues that the beings behind UFOs (unidentified flying objects) may be humans from the future, traces a line of time travel ideas through physics. He says that after work by Albert Einstein and later models by the physicists van Stockum and Kurt Gödel, a physicist named Frank Tipler in the 1970s shrank the required machine down to a finite size: a rapidly rotating ring, sphere or disc. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, repeats the idea, calling Tipler a contemporary of the physicist Wheeler and saying the so-called Tipler disc is basically a flying saucer. If they are right, the classic saucer shape could be the shape of a time machine.
